newsitem.title: USA: Capstone Capital buys health care properties.
newsitem.headline: Capstone Capital buys health care properties.

text.p: Capstone Capital Corp. said Tuesday it has acquired seven health care related properties in two deals valued at $30 million.
Capstone entered into a joint venture with a private, long-term care developer to purchase six nursing homes in Virginia and North Carolina for $23.9 million.
Capstone also acquired the Daniel Medical Building in Winter Park, Fla., for $6.1 million.
"We continue to see solid opportunities to acquire and finance healthcare related real estate," said Capstone Chief Executive John McRoberts.
Capstone, based in Birmingham, Ala., is a real estate investment trust that owns, leases and provides mortgage financing for health care properties in 21 states.
